serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin; each bucket's own table (capacity_bookings Order / maintenance_bookings / unassigned_services) for bookedMin; service_capacities reserved_minutes carried as ledgerBookedMin only.
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled labour minutes set aside for the bucket; bookedMin is the authoritative booked load from that bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin is the service_capacities reserved figure, kept only so its drift stays visible and never used as the booked side; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity.

orderCapacity.note: Static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series: the same ceiling applies every day until the lot is edited. daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity', not an all-order ceiling. null means not configured, not a ceiling of zero.
